messages:
sara-sales: Quick heads-up — FinTech POC hitting a blocker. They want to pin model to avoid drift (redwood-3b-v2) and require EU residency. When they call from eu-west-1 they get an error. Also asked about Dedicated pricing vs hosted for ~100k tokens/day and KMS/audit requirements. Can we swarm?

raj-eng: Can you paste the exact error and the request body?

sara-sales: Error paste below:
```
error: MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_REGION
message: model 'redwood-3b-v2' is deprecated in eu-west-1
request: {"model":"redwood-3b-v2","region":"eu-west-1","version_pin":"v2","input":"..."}
```

emily-ps: Ok — common situation. Options: 1) point them at our stable alias that maps to a supported build in eu-west (no infra change), 2) cross-region routing to us-west-2 (bad for data residency), 3) spin up Dedicated/reserved pool in eu-west and republish the pinned variant (SLA + cost). For POC I'd try (1) first.

marcus-infra: Quick check for availability: run `curl -s "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models?region=eu-west-1" | jq '.models[] | {name,versions,status}'` — sample output below shows which variants are live:
```
{"name":"redwood-3b-stable","versions":["v3","v3a"],"status":"available"}
{"name":"redwood-3b-v2","versions":[],"status":"deprecated"}
{"name":"redwood-3b-quantized-v2","versions":["v2q"],"status":"available"}
```
If they insist on v2 exactly, we can promote the quantized v2 as a pinned fallback alias `redwood-3b-v2-pin` in eu-west. Estimated work: ~2 business days to validate and run perf tests.

lisa-security: For the security questionnaire: we support customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM), full audit logs in Console (retention options), VPC peering for Private, and SOC2 + ISO27001 controls. Note: if we do cross-region routing, data will transit regions — must document that in the questionnaire and get legal signoff. If EU residency is required, recommend Dedicated or Private deployment.

raj-eng: Short-term workaround for the POC: config example that uses alias (no client changes besides model name):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-3b-stable",
  "input": "<prompt>",
  "region": "eu-west-1"
}
```
This will give them a pinned, supported model in eu-west while we decide on Dedicated.

sara-sales: They want a cost ballpark for 100k tokens/day, with test bursts to 300k/day for a week. Also need to confirm: will switching alias change output quality (they worry about drift).

emily-ps: I'll send a short pricing calc offline, but rough guidance: hosted (metered) will be cheapest for short POC; Dedicated has higher commit but gives predictable latency and EU residency. Alias swap should not materially change quality if we map to same family — but we'll run the customer's eval prompts against the alias to validate.

marcus-infra: I can provision a temporary dedicated pool in eu-west with soft quota for POC if they agree to a short-term commitment. Need billing contact + PO. If we need the exact v2 binary, we can republish after compatibility tests.

deploy-bot: canary: alias redwood-3b-stable -> eu-west-1 rollout complete :white_check_mark:

sara-sales: Awesome — I'll propose alias route to the customer and attach the security note. Marcus — I'll DM billing contact and expected PO timeline. Emily — please attach the pricing calc.

raj-eng: Action items: 1) Emily send pricing sheet; 2) Marcus hold a 2-day slot to validate quantized v2 if customer needs exact pin; 3) Lisa add a short note for the security questionnaire about cross-region transit. I'll monitor logs for any further MODEL_* errors.

marcus-infra: noted. ping me when the PO lands.

emily-ps: sending pricing now (DM).

sara-sales: thanks team :pray: I'll update customer and follow up in this thread if they accept alias.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from raj-eng, :white_check_mark: from marcus-infra)
